propositions: Bypass architecture: v2 hook <-> judge service <-> Ollama <-> local model full chain verified
Fail-soft: timeout / connection refused / non-200 / malformed schema -> None, static verdict stands (4 degradation paths tested)
Upgrade-only: static DENY final; hook skipped for DENY (zero calls); ALLOW may upgrade to ESCALATE, upgrade fully audited
Opt-in: SEMANTIC_HOOK_ENABLED=0 -> zero judge traffic, zero behavioral change
Zero regression: 215/215 tests (201 baseline + 14 new), GATE 1 (445 asserts 0 dataclass) / GATE 2 (202 tests) green
